original_requirement: Implement REASONING_ONLY_MAX_TOKENS_GUARD_V1 so an exact reasoning/thinking-only max_tokens provider response becomes a typed failure, records exact route capability negative memory, never repeats the same fingerprint, uses only an existing distinct route, and otherwise fails closed without changing Prompt, Model, Route, contract, retry limits, budget, StoryState, Canon or READY authority.
closed_world_justification: The authorized detector is an explicitly finite conjunction: output-limit finish, known reasoning blocks present, known text/tool and raw/normalized visible output absent, unknown block count zero, exact adapter projection, and completed transport. The user separately requires unknown shapes not to be inferred, so unseen provider representations intentionally remain outside this typed label rather than broadening acceptance.
operational_definition: ModelGateway projects the retained raw state of all three production adapters into one privacy-safe ProviderOutputShapeV1, raises ReasoningOnlyFinalArtifactUnavailableError before parser/schema execution, and quarantines the exact provider/model/fingerprint/contract/schema under final_artifact. Contract Runtime skips the remaining same-route attempts, advances only through its immutable configured route schedule, and raises FinalArtifactCapabilityExhaustedError when no distinct route succeeds.
forbidden_narrowing: No provider, model, route alias, story, genre, project ID, raw error string, or planning-only branch
No Prompt, business contract, validator, token budget, reasoning setting, model identity, provider identity, configured route order, or retry/fallback limit change
No inference from parameter acceptance or unknown content blocks
No parser/schema failure or generic ContractOutputLimitExhaustedError for the exact guarded shape
